sourceDatePolicy: Date ranges, source-of-fact and unresolved conflicts are recorded explicitly. No first-party methodology is inferred from earlier waves.
normalisationPolicy: A separately published Others category is different from a computed four-party residual; where only four categories are published, record residual as a mathematical difference and do not mark it source-verified.

evidence.primaryPollsterMethodology: Poll page discloses rim-weighted age x gender, education, household income, language and federal vote; excludes 6% don't know and 5% refused; leaner treatment provided. TKW and DemosAU local poll.
evidence.nonOverlapClaim: Same DemosAU participant/panel family may overlap Nov statewide wave; no independence established. Local electorate sample cannot be pooled as independent Victoria-wide wave.
evidence.reason: Seat poll is not a statewide poll event; cannot be added to statewide polling registry. Keep as independent local diagnostic with uncertainty and unknown respondent overlap.
